description: READ-ONLY (builds no tx). Lists every Uniswap v3 position NFT `owner` holds on `chainId` via the NonfungiblePositionManager, with each position's full state (token0/token1, fee, tickLower/tickUpper, liquidity, tokensOwed0/1) — feed a positionId straight into build_collect/build_close/build_increase.
name: get_positions
title: List a wallet's Uniswap v3 positions
